name: Incode
description: Incode is an Italian creative studio founded in 2007, specialising in full-stack development, e-commerce, custom web applications, UX/UI design and UX research. Based in Cremona and Asola (Mantua), Italy, Incode also works as a white-label development partner for agencies across Italy and Europe.
descriptionShort: Italian creative studio for full-stack development, UX/UI, websites and custom digital products.

services.name: Websites & E-commerce
services.description: Design and development of websites and online stores with WordPress, WooCommerce, Drupal, Drupal Commerce and Shopify, including B2B and wholesale portals with customer-specific catalogues and price lists.

services.name: Custom software projects
services.description: Custom full-stack applications with Ruby on Rails, Node.js, Vue.js and Astro: management platforms, product configurators, booking systems, data dashboards, geoportals and LLM-based tools, including architecture and system integration.

services.name: UX & UI design
services.description: User experience and interface design in Figma, including design systems, component libraries and documented component guidelines, delivered standalone or as the first phase of a project Incode develops.

services.name: UX research & usability testing
services.description: Heuristic evaluations, moderated usability tests, benchmarking studies, A/B tests and metric-based testing, run since 2018 for organisations in banking, insurance, energy, telecommunications, travel, retail and publishing.

services.name: White-label development for agencies
services.description: Technical subcontracting for agencies and studios under their brand, from front-end and CMS development to complete back-end builds, with Incode handling architecture, development and release.

services.name: Migration & replatforming
services.description: Takeover of sites built by other suppliers: codebase and infrastructure audit, restyling, replatforming, content migration from legacy CMS installations and Drupal 7, 8 and 9 upgrades to Drupal 11.

services.name: Maintenance & technical support
services.description: Continuous technical support, security updates, CMS version upgrades and incremental development for sites already in production, including platforms Incode did not originally build.
